summary: Patch 3 GHL Lead Sync Foundation — created /app/backend/tests/test_ghl.py with 30 focused tests using FastAPI TestClient (in-process) so monkeypatched ghl_client.fetch_* and GHL_READ_SYNC_ENABLED env flag take effect at request time. Covers: /api/ghl/status, mappings CRUD/validation/RBAC/tenant-isolation/status transitions, pull-preview (blocked paths + happy path), pull-preview RBAC, pull-sync RBAC, pull-sync insert→update idempotency, email fallback, tenant isolation, purchase override, write-back-preview (blocked + happy path), secret sanitization, dashboards (leads_by_source/leads_by_temperature/ghl_mirrored_leads_count + event ghl_status). All 30 new tests + 66 regression = 96/96 pass.

minor.issue: No such endpoint — leads are only available via /api/events/{event_id}/leads. Tests updated accordingly. Consider adding a global /api/leads listing for parity with dashboards.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2199 lines — recommend splitting into routers/ghl.py, routers/dashboard.py, routers/kpi.py, etc. (>700 line guideline).

DELETE /api/ghl/mappings/{mid} silently returns {"deleted": 0} with 200 when mid does not belong to tenant. Tenant isolation is preserved (verified in tests) but the test spec asked for 404 — behavior is safe but semantically loose. Consider returning 404 when deleted_count==0.

LeadOut.event_id is required; pull-sync will fail Pydantic validation if body.event_id is None and no existing lead matches (mid-loop unhandled). Callers must pass event_id. Consider defaulting or making event_id optional on LeadOut.
Two @app.on_event handlers deprecated by FastAPI — migrate to lifespan handlers.
GhlMappingIn.ghl_name is `str` (required); tests must send empty string "" to hit the 400 validator path. Consider making it Optional[str] so 400 is the sole error path.
audit_logs sanitization: `audit()` metadata is freeform. Adding a redaction filter (or a strict metadata schema) would harden secret leakage prevention. Currently verified via string scan only.
seed_data_creation: Session-scoped: Tenant B (via Motor), marketing/sales/viewer test users (via API), one TEST_GHL_Event. Session teardown deletes tenant B, TEST_ghl_ users, TEST_GHL_ events, ghl_mappings/integrations for default tenant, and gohighlevel-linked/marker leads.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with default parallel config: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q`. All 96 pass. For debugging test_ghl.py alone, use `-n 0` (serial) because integration/mapping state is shared per-tenant across xdist workers if you split test_ghl.py into multiple modules. Real HTTP is blocked via monkeypatch of ghl_client.fetch_contacts / fetch_opportunities — never call real GHL.
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs; happy-path implementation of Patch 3 verified end-to-end.
